what: RS05 actuator and stand parameters fitted to the real lf leg on the single-leg stand (2026-11-09), against the training simulator's values
bus: vcan0 via rs_bridge (CH340 USB-CAN, 921600 baud), RobStride MIT mode, commands at 100 Hz, targets at 50 Hz

fitted_real.observed_delay_controls: about 2 (actuation about 1 control plus feedback read up to 10 ms stale)
fitted_real.torque_ceiling_nm: not identified: the stand peaked at 0.8-0.9 Nm
fitted_real.notes: kp from the position fit trades off against damping and delay; the motors' own torque readings give kp 0.81-1.12x nominal, so treat stiffness as nominal

validation.held_out: leg_20261109T151125: RMS coxa 0.40->0.16, femur 1.02->0.74, tibia 0.47->0.46 deg (default -> fitted)
validation.foot_down: three recordings: femur improves on all; coxa and tibia worse than the default on two of three

maps.action_delay_controls: the fitted delay: 1 control actuation, 2 with stale feedback
maps.kd_scale: fitted 0.13-0.37x lies below DynamicsRandomization's 0.5 bound: 0.5-0.7 is the closest the current trainer allows
maps.friction_scale: toe friction 0.52 against the training 1.0 (scales every contact's friction)
maps.contact: friction randomization needs touchdown_overshoot=False (the touchdown correction reads one shared contact friction); the sim2real adapter runs used it too

surrogate_training.usage: append the flags to a locomotion.surrogate.train command; they draw per episode from these ranges
surrogate_training.example: uv run python -m locomotion.surrogate.train --output OUT --task "locomotion.omniwalk.destination_task:experiment_task(destination_v70)" --wrapper locomotion.rl.destination_wrapper:DestinationVecEnv --initialize-from records/curriculum_20261109/od1/checkpoint_update001200.pt --initialize-rate checkpoint --action-mean tanh --observation-normalization none --observation-scaling fixed --command-segments bootstrap --learning-rate-max 1e-4 --action-std 0.05 --action-std-final 0.05 --gait-clock 60 --action-smoothing mean2 --velocity-noise 0.5 --episode-seconds 32.0 --updates 2000 --seed SEED --threads 6 --anchor-weight 0.006 --contact "touchdown_overshoot=False" --randomize "action_delay_controls=(1, 2)" --randomize "kd_scale=(0.5, 0.7)" --randomize "friction_scale=(0.45, 0.6)" --ppo-config-overrides '{"num_steps_per_env": 36, "algorithm": {"num_mini_batches": 6}, "environment_wrapper": {"destination_input": "terrain_v2_odom", "gait_clock_scaling": "speed_v1"}}'
surrogate_training.smoke_tested: 2026-11-10: a 2-update run from od1 u1200 with these flags completed and recorded the randomization in its checkpoint identity
